payload.title: Seek supported animation frameworks deterministically
payload.description:
## Behavior
As an effect author, I can use any animation framework that satisfies VideoML’s frame contract.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given a fixed seed and assets, when frames are requested forward, backward, repeated, and out of order, then equivalent visual states are produced within documented tolerances.
Given asynchronous fonts, textures, or setup, capture waits for readiness. A framework integration must not require wall-clock playback; do not mandate GSAP.

## Ownership
toolchain, specification, player, stdlib; consult Babulus

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
